answer_1.quote: Experiments on math and code benchmarks show that DPTS achieves the highest reasoning accuracy while delivering 2-4× speedup.
answer_1.outputs: Generated reasoning solutions and code outputs

answer_2.quote: On math tasks, we record the correctness of the answers as the accuracy (Acc.). On code generation benchmark, we report Pass@1 to measure the generation quality.

answer_3.quote: Without specified, our default PRM is the math-shepherd-mistral-7b-prm ... it leverages a completer to extend intermediate steps of a reasoning chain into multiple complete paths, then estimates the quality of each step based on the correctness of the resulting answers.
